softwareInnerHero.title: Autodesk AEC Collection
paragraphs: The AEC Collection offers a complete suite of essential software tools for building design, civil infrastructure, and construction management. With up-to-date software releases and cloud-based collaboration features, teams can streamline workflows, enhance productivity, and deliver high-quality construction and engineering projects.

From conceptual modeling to detailed documentation and construction coordination, the AEC Collection supports every stage of the project lifecycle with integrated, discipline-specific workflows. It provides advanced solutions for structural engineering, MEP design, civil engineering, and construction planning—all in one cost-effective package designed to support local industry standards, improve accuracy, and optimize project performance.

cardSections.subheading: Comprehensive tools for every stage of your project

items.body: Professional 2D and 3D CAD software for drafting, design, and documentation.
